description: Runs the workspace application's original Server Action and services against a disposable PostgreSQL database, one process per actor.

createWorkspaceAction.description: The Server Action withUser(callback); the harness calls the action inside a session, the model checks the callback.

createWorkspace.description: Check for an existing workspace of the owner, then create one with a generated id and add the owner's membership.

createWorkspaceLocked.description: The same check under SELECT ... FOR UPDATE of the owner's row.

addWorkspace.description: Create a workspace (generated id) and the owner's membership; resubmitted after a lost response.

addWorkspaceIdempotent.description: The same with the request id as the workspace's key.

registerUser.description: Insert a user (database-generated id), its first workspace and membership from the returned ids.

inviteToWorkspace.description: Check for a pending invite in a transaction; UNIQUE(workspace_id, email).
